the_dark_hall.title: The Dark Hall
offer: Three nights ago the duel hall went dark. Every candle, all at once. Brann hasn't lit one since.
Now the chapel graves are open and the dead walk the moor. Their tracks lead to the old mill.
Under the mill lie the Warrens. Someone there is raising the dead with Echoes gone wrong. Hushed.
I am too old to go down. Orrin is gone. That leaves you. Will you go?
accepted: Good. Take the east gate, then the road past the chapel. The mill's stairs go under the wheel.
And scribe. If you find anything of Orrin's down there, bring it to me. Anything at all.
declined: Then sharpen your deck and think on it. The dead are patient. I am less so.
progress: The Warrens are still under the mill, and the dead still walk. Go down. Find who calls them.
ready: You beat the Grave Priest. I felt the hall light from here. My knees stopped aching. Odd, that.
And this paper was on him? Give it here. That's Orrin's hand. He always crossed his sevens.
A map. The Marches, the Drowned Coast, and a mark on Saltmere. 'Ferry east,' he's written.
So he went over the water. Then so must you. Take the map, and this purse for the road.
done: The map is yours now. Follow it to the coast. Find the ferryman who took Orrin east.
the_dark_hall.journal: Find who raised the dead below the old mill, and why the duel hall went dark.

lamplighters_debt.title: The Lamplighter's Debt
offer: Can I ask you a thing? A big thing? It's one thing. One bandit. The big one.
The Ember lot on the road keep taking my oil. I bought it on credit from Brackwater. Now I owe.
Beat their leader by the bridge and they'll keep off the road. I can pay. Orrin left me a card.
accepted: Really? Thank you! They wear red sashes. You'll see them on the road, near the bridge.
Don't let them talk you into a deal. They always win the deals.
declined: No, that's fair. They're very rude bandits. I'll just. Stand here. In the dark.
progress: Still bandits on the road? Their leader's by the bridge. Biggest sash. Beat him and they scatter.
ready: Their leader's beaten! The road's clear! A cart came in this morning with all its oil. All of it!
Here. Master Orrin gave me this for lighting the hall. He said I'd know who to give it to.
done: Every lamp on the square is lit. I'm going to stand under them all evening. Just because.
lamplighters_debt.journal: Beat the Ember Bandits' leader by the bridge on the east road so Pell's oil carts get through.
